origin.usage:
na.locf(object, na.rm = TRUE, ...)
na.locf.default(object, na.rm = TRUE, fromLast, rev, maxgap = Inf, rule = 2, ...)

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, leading NAs that remain are removed.

arguments.name: fromLast
arguments.text: If TRUE, carry the next observation backward.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: Runs longer than maxgap are left missing.

arguments.name: x, xout
arguments.text: If supplied, the fill is a constant approx with the given rule.

origin.details: Each missing value is replaced by the most recent non-missing observation before it. With na.rm TRUE, a leading gap is trimmed.
origin.value: The carried-forward series. c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) returns 1, 1, 3, 3, 3.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.locf(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
